# Ravi Raj

> Politics, Culture & Calculated Contradictions

## About

Personal homepage of Ravi Raj. "Dualities" is a collection of my unapologetic thoughts on politics, law, and lies.

## Posts

- [Why Is the Race to Become More Backward India's Biggest Nightmare?](https://raviraj.dpdns.org/post/why-race-to-backwardness-is-india-s-biggest-nightmare/): Being weaker in India is a superpower. The weaker you appear, the more the government will try to empower you.
